Create a Credit Memo type Invoice for the specified Invoice with reverse parties, item for amount specified, etc.
With linkToOriginal the credit is a finance credit linked to its original (creditForInvoiceId): the original must be issued and the user hold its side's edit permission (RECEIVABLE_EDIT or PAYABLE_EDIT) in the organization; the credits of an original stay within its total; the credit is a draft on the original's side (a customer credit is a receivable draft). With allocateToLines the amount is split over the original's lines, each on the account its line posted to, instead of one item. With an operationKey the same request answers the first result.
With linkToOriginal and promptDiscount the credit is the prompt-payment discount the original's due schedule offers on the credit's date (at most that, DISCOUNT_NOT_AVAILABLE), on the side's discount account unless one is given: it is issued at once, finalized as the organization's own credit with no approval step, for a user with the side's edit permission or PAYMENT_EDIT (a payment run's executor).

A bad address is named in recipientResults and the others are sent. The same operationKey and request answers the first result. Take a supplier's bill into an organization: a draft bill (InvoiceIncoming, create#Invoice) with the supplier's reference, one line for the amount when given, and the file as its content. Keyed by organization, supplier and the supplier's reference: a second bill with the same reference is refused (BILL_DUPLICATE), naming the first. For a receipt (shipmentId) billed as a draft with no supplier reference (a self-billed draft), the file is attached to that draft, which takes the reference (attached true); a receipt whose bill has a reference or is no longer a draft is refused (BILL_DUPLICATE, naming it). Needs PAYABLE_IMPORT in the organization, as AP intake and a buyer hold it; an order given must be the organization's from this supplier. The same operationKey and request answers the first result.

service.description: The bill of a purchase order part, or the invoice of a sales order part: on the ordered basis the order's unbilled lines (create#EntireOrderPartInvoice), on the received basis, for a purchase, the accepted quantity of its delivered receipts or of the receipt given (create#PurchaseShipmentInvoices, acceptedOnly). The order's payments are marked for the invoice and apply when it is approved or finalized. A bill takes the supplier's payment term (checkSet#InvoiceDueDate). Refuses an order not approved, a source already invoiced (SOURCE_ALREADY_INVOICED, naming the invoice) and nothing left to bill. Needs PAYABLE_EDIT for a purchase, RECEIVABLE_EDIT for a sale, in the organization. The same operationKey and request answers the first result.

service.description: Approve a bill: its posting day when given (accountingDate, a draft's book day in an open period), then change#InvoiceState's approval, which posts it and stamps the approver (self-approved when the approver drafted it), its budget commitments converted to actual (change#InvoiceState calls mantle.other.BudgetServices.convert#Commitment with invoiceId: a purchase order line's commitment passes to the bill line, and a Stop over budget refuses the approval unless budgetOverrideReason is given by a user holding BUDGET_OVERRIDE), and its BillApproval notifications marked read. Refuses a receivable, a bill on hold (INVOICE_HELD), a budget Stop (BUDGET_EXCEEDED) and a stale lastUpdatedStamp. Needs INVOICE_APPROVE in the organization.

service.description: Place a hold on a bill (InvoiceHold): while it is open the bill is not approved and no payment or credit is applied to it. Refuses a receivable, a cancelled or paid bill, a reason that is not an InvoiceHoldReason and a second open hold for the same reason. Needs INVOICE_HOLD in the organization.

Ask for an open hold to be released: the request is recorded on the hold and the BillHoldRelease notification goes to the organization's users who may release it (INVOICE_HOLD_RELEASE). Refuses a released hold. Needs PAYABLE_EDIT in the organization.

HOLD_ALREADY_RELEASED: The hold is already released

service.description: Release an open hold, recording who released it, when and why, and mark its BillHoldRelease notifications read. When the last hold of an approved bill is released, the payments for it left unapplied (PAYMENT_HELD) are applied (apply#InvoiceForPayments). Refuses the user who placed the hold (HOLD_RELEASE_SELF), a released hold and a release without a reason. Needs INVOICE_HOLD_RELEASE in the organization.

return.message: HOLD_UNAVAILABLE: The hold is not available
HOLD_ALREADY_RELEASED: The hold is already released
HOLD_RELEASE_SELF: Another approver must release a hold you placed
REASON_REQUIRED: Give the reason for the release

service.description: A bill's holds, newest first, with reason and user names, and what the user may do: place a hold (INVOICE_HOLD), release one placed by another user (INVOICE_HOLD_RELEASE), ask for a release (PAYABLE_EDIT), send the bill for approval (PAYABLE_EDIT) and approve it (INVOICE_APPROVE, no open hold). Needs the invoice's view permission in the organization.

Finalize the shipment's sales invoices still in process, as create#SalesShipmentInvoices does at pack without the flag, dated the ship day (invoice date, book day and due date): each moves to InvoiceFinalized (whose SECAs post it, apply the payments that name it and send it), and the order parts' captured payments are applied (apply#OrderPaymentsToInvoice). Run by the ShipmentShippedFinalizeInvoices SECA.

Take a packed shipment's lines off its sales invoice before it ships, for a reopened package or an order change (D3): the invoice lines billed for the shipment and their billing links (OrderItemBilling) are removed, the shipment's sources and issuances no longer name the invoice, and an invoice left with no line is cancelled, so packing again bills the shipment again. Captured payments stay unapplied (PaymentServices.refund#OrderPayment refunds one when the change reduces the order). Refuses a shipment that shipped (SHIPMENT_SHIPPED: after ship a change is a return or a credit memo) and an invoice no longer in process (INVOICE_FINALIZED). Needs RECEIVABLE_EDIT in the shipping organization. The same operationKey and request answers the first result.

return.message: SHIPMENT_UNAVAILABLE: Shipment ${shipmentId} is not available
SHIPMENT_SHIPPED: Shipment ${shipmentId} has shipped; change it with a return or a credit memo
INVOICE_FINALIZED: Invoice ${invoiceId} is not in process; correct it with a credit memo

service.description: Write an issued invoice's due schedule from its term's lines in effect on the invoice date, once: the InvoiceIssuedDueSchedule SECA calls it when an invoice is finalized or a bill approved. Nothing for a credit memo, an invoice without a date or total, or one that has its schedule; a later term change never changes it.
Remove the due schedule of an issued invoice changed back for edits (the InvoiceResumedDueSchedule SECA), so issuing it again writes the schedule of what it then is.

An invoice's due schedule: each portion's due date and amount and its discount, open or not on the day given (today by default), and the discount still available then, less prompt-payment discounts already credited and at most the unpaid total. An invoice issued before its term had lines, or not yet issued, shows the schedule its term gives without storing it. Needs a read of the invoice (its side's view permission or ACCOUNTING_VIEW).
